policy: Preserve USB differential/debug, I2S, crystal/QSPI, boost/protection/sense and thermal structures.
Do not route new fast signals through the clock void or assume continuous In1 beneath it.
VCORE, power/current, private return and plane decisions remain Astra-reserved.
SCL/GAIN retain congestion reservations; reset requires recovery/noise review.

proposed_coherent_batches.name: Return and local-ground disposition
constraints: Resolve return/plane access before signals that depend on these local references.
Preserve both private pickoffs, protected In1, contact reservations, clock/boost exclusions and C24 filled/capped process binding.

proposed_coherent_batches.name: Peripheral low-speed controls by shared physical corridor
constraints: Not automatically released; exclude central MCU/core/USB and boost/audio power corridors.
Keep reset recovery access and noise immunity.
Batch only groups whose recorded bounds support a shared corridor after return disposition.
